decisions.lean: A concentrated, defensively-tilted expression of Flagship's confirmed rotation. Flagship's pending orders are the tell — it is SELLING semis/momentum/small-caps (SMH, MTUM, IWM) and BUYING defensives (XLV, XLP), and it vetoed financials (cycle_blocked). I press that with one high-conviction name per cluster: XLV (the firm's #1 research score at 94, tape-confirmed defensive leadership, and being added) as the largest weight; ANET as the single best-confirmed tech leg (82/100, confluence +0.33, size_authority UP — beating AAPL/XLK); and XLE as an uncorrelated real-asset diversifier carrying the highest confluence (+0.50) of any holding. I hold ~50% cash deliberately: the posture is ROTATE_DEFENSIVE, the regime flip is fragile/transitioning, and my track record (36% hit-rate, negative book edge) argues against diluting into weak second-tier names — doctrine says hold cash when conviction is thin and lean on the highest-rated ideas. My sizing skill is positive (+0.06), so I trust concentration into the top name (XLV) rather than spreading thin.

Exited nothing else new; XLV retained and pressed up from a 2.6% toe-hold to the book's anchor weight.
